turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.text: Not too much, we're keeping it pretty low-key. We plan on winding down tonight by watching a cooking competition show together on TV.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, those cooking competition shows can be so addictive! Do they ever inspire you to try out new chemistry-like experiments in the kitchen?

turns.text: Haha, sometimes! Being a chemistry teacher, I do appreciate the science behind some of the molecular gastronomy stuff they do. But mostly we just like to guess who is going to get eliminated.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It definitely makes for great, relaxed viewing. Well, I hope you enjoy the show and have a wonderful rest of your Wednesday evening!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I appreciate it. Talk to you tomorrow!
